title: FIRST HOME BUYER GUIDE: GRANTS & TIPS FOR 2026
author: Finnova Financial Inclusion Team
excerpt: Buying your first home is an exciting milestone. Learn about the First Home Owner Grant (FHOG), stamp duty concessions, 5% deposit schemes, and securing competitive loan rates in 2026.
body:
💡 Executive Summary & Key Takeaways

In 2026, eligible Australian first home buyers can access direct capital grants up to ,000, full stamp duty waivers, and the Federal Home Guarantee Scheme allowing purchases with only a 5% deposit without paying Lender's Mortgage Insurance (LMI).
1. 2026 State-by-State Grant & Duty Concession Breakdown

2. The Federal Home Guarantee Scheme (5% Deposit, No LMI)

Under traditional lending criteria, purchasing a home with less than a 20% deposit requires paying Lender's Mortgage Insurance (LMI) — an upfront cost ranging from ,000 to ,000. However, through Housing Australia's First Home Guarantee (FHBG), eligible buyers can secure a home loan with as little as a 5% deposit while the Federal Government guarantees up to 15% of the loan value.

📌 Key Eligibility Requirements for the 5% Deposit Scheme:

  • Must be an Australian citizen or Permanent Resident aged 18+.
  • Income cap: Single applicants up to ,000 per annum; Joint applicants up to ,000 per annum.
  • Property price caps: Greater Melbourne (,000), Regional Victoria (,000), Sydney (,000), Brisbane (,000).
  • Must be an owner-occupier residential property (not an investment).
3. Step-by-Step Purchasing Roadmap for 2026

1

Credit Audit & Savings Benchmark

Ensure 3–6 months of clean bank statements, eliminate credit card limits, and demonstrate genuine savings equal to at least 5% of your target purchase price.

2

Pre-Approval with Accredited Lender

Work with an accredited broker or financial counselor to submit formal pre-approval applications and lock in home guarantee allocation spots.

3

Conveyancing & Settlement Assistance

Engage a licensed conveyancer or solicitor to review Section 32 vendor statements, verify title details, and process government grant applications prior to settlement.
4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

❓ Can I claim the FHOG on an existing established house?

In most states including Victoria and NSW, the First Home Owner Grant (,000) applies exclusively to newly constructed homes, off-the-plan apartments, or substantially renovated properties. However, established homes are still eligible for full or partial stamp duty exemptions.

💡 Free NDIS Plan Guidance for Australians

Finnova Ltd provides free independent NDIS Navigator guidance to help people with disability, carers, and families access funding for screen readers, specialized tablets, communication software, and local support services.
1. Understanding Assistive Technology (AT) Funding under NDIS in 2026

Under the 2026 NDIS Quality and Safeguards Framework, participants can claim low-cost, mid-cost, and high-cost Assistive Technology directly from their Capital and Core budgets without unnecessary administrative delays.

• Low-Cost AT (Under ,500): Specialized keyboards, adapted touch tablets, magnification tools, and eye-tracking mounts.
  • Mid-Cost AT (,500 – ,000): Customized wheelchairs, motorized ramps, specialized speech devices (AAC).
  • High-Cost AT (,000+): Complex environmental controls, home automation integrations, and robotic aids.
2. How Finnova Helps You Prepare for NDIS Plan Reviews

Our bilingual mentors sit down with participants to compile occupational therapy reports, quote comparisons, and evidence letters to present to your NDIS Local Area Coordinator (LAC) during plan reviews.
